description: Send a repurpose draft to a connected scheduler's channels: Postiz or Buffer (schedule, save as a draft, or add to Buffer's queue). YouTube and TikTok drafts are recording scripts and never push. PUBLICLY VISIBLE side effect: defaults to a DRY RUN. When the person asked for this, call it with confirm=true.

confirm.description: Set true to send it to the scheduler (default: dry run)

integrationIds.description: Channel ids from list_postiz_channels (required with confirm)

scheduleType.description: Default draft; queue is Buffer only

scheduler.description: Which scheduler; required when both are connected

name: push_repurpose_draft
